Guest Mode
Guest Mode refers to a browsing mode in which personalized features like the PF (Personalized feed) are not active.

PF
PF (Personalized feed) refers to a default feature related to user browsing experience that will be disabled in guest mode.

SB 976
SB 976 is a California law designed to protect minors from addictive internet-based services by setting notification restrictions and requiring parental consent.

Age-Appropriate Design Code Act
The Age-Appropriate Design Code Act mandates that operators consider the impact of their services on children's use and protect their personal information.

Compliance Detection System (CDS)
The Compliance Detection System is used to verify enforcement of regulations concerning age-sensitive notifications.

California
California is a U.S. state that has specific laws regarding age-sensitive notifications for minors, particularly under SB 976 and the Age-Appropriate Design Code Act.

California Attorney General
The California Attorney General is responsible for enforcing SB 976 and developing regulations regarding age assurance and parental consent.

California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act
The California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act establishes rules regarding the design and operation of online services to protect minors and ensure age-appropriate content and interactions.<SEP>The California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act mandates businesses to assess the impact of their design on children's safety and well-being.

EchoTrace
EchoTrace is a log tracing mode used for verifying compliance routing in the context of age-sensitive notifications.

addictive internet-based services or applications
Addictive internet-based services or applications refer to platforms that may contribute to addictive behaviors, particularly among minors, and are subject to California regulations.

DPIA
DPIA (Data Protection Impact Assessment) relates to the requirement to assess how design features affect children's use of services and to document the analysis.

State of California
The State of California is a U.S. state where the Attorney General enforces regulations concerning child protection and data privacy.

data protection impact assessment
A data protection impact assessment evaluates how a business's design could potentially harm children and influences their online engagement.

parental consent regulations
Parental consent regulations are part of the measures included within the California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act, requiring safeguards to protect children online.

California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act (DPIA and child-protection duties)
The California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act encompasses duties related to data protection impact assessments and aims to ensure that design elements do not harm children.

Attorney General
The Attorney General is a legal office responsible for enforcing the regulations established by the California Age-Appropriate Design Code Act, focusing on child protection duties.
